# Consultico

> Consultico is a Glasgow-based digital marketing consultancy led by founder Paul Wilson. It runs a consult-first model with a "Think First" workshop as the entry point, serving B2C brands and trades businesses across the UK and the United States.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.consultico.co.uk/): Overview of Consultico's digital marketing consulting, services and approach.
- [Think First](https://www.consultico.co.uk/think-first): The entry-point strategy workshop that defines scope before any execution.

## Optional
- [Contact](https://www.consultico.co.uk/#contact): How to reach Paul Wilson and the team.
